	set_variable = { wif_air_cap = 0 }
	123 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	125 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	126 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }

	128 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	129 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	338 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 1 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_1 } } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_hold_1 days = 30 value = 1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 1 crowded, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_1
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 1 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_1
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_1
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_1
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_1 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_1 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

	735 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	806 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	851 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 20 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_20 } } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_hold_20 days = 30 value = 1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 20 crowded, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_20 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_20 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 20 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_20
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_20
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_20 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_20 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }

				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_91 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_91 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 91 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }

		}
	}
	else = {

		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_91
	}

		}

		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_116
	}
	if = {

	943 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }

		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 125 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }

			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_125
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_125 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_125 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 125 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_125
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_125
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_125
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_125 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_125 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

	783 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 182 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_182 } } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_hold_182 days = 30 value = 1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 182 crowded, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_182
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_182 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_182 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 182 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_182
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_182
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_182
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_182 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_182 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

	371 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	372 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 211 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_211 } } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_hold_211 days = 30 value = 1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 211 crowded, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_211
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_211 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_211 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 211 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_211
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_211
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_211
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_211 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_211 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

	331 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	332 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	730 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	860 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 220 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_220 } } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_hold_220 days = 30 value = 1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 220 crowded, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_220
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_220 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_220 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 220 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_220
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_220
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_220
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_220 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_220 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

	279 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	506 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	508 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	511 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	951 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	952 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	959 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	960 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 284 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_284 } } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_hold_284 days = 30 value = 1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 284 crowded, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_284
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_284 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_284 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 284 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_284
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_284
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_284
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_284 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_284 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

wif_air_yield_region_303 = {
	set_variable = { wif_air_cap = 0 }
	522 = { if = { limit = { air_base > 0 controller = { wif_air_friend_of_root = yes } } add_to_variable = { ROOT.wif_air_cap = building_level@air_base } } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_cap > 0 } }
		set_variable = { wif_air_region = 303 }
		wif_air_count_region = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_hi = 180 }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = wif_air_cap }
		multiply_temp_variable = { wif_air_lo = 140 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_air_used > wif_air_hi } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_303 } } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_hold_303 days = 30 value = 1 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 303 crowded, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			set_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_303
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { wif_air_used < wif_air_lo }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_air_hold_303 }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_303 } log = "WiF air yield: [ROOT.GetTag] region 303 released, [?wif_air_used|0] planes, room for [?wif_air_cap|0] levels" }
			clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_303
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_303
		clr_country_flag = wif_air_hold_303
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_air_crowded_303 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = wif_air_friends
			if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_country_flag = { flag = wif_air_yield_303 days = 10 value = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
